name: Nishimeya (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nishimeya village emblem in white: a stylised bird with a large wing, like a letter F.
history: Municipal flag of Nishimeya, a village in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 December 1966.

features.role: Nishimeya village emblem — a stylised bird with a large wing, like a letter F
